Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Product Designer position at Monzo. Although my professional journey began as a barista, it has shaped a strong foundation in customer empathy, rapid problem‑solving, and iterative learning—all essential traits for a designer who thrives on user‑centric solutions.

In the past two years I have independently taught myself Figma, honing my ability to prototype, iterate, and present design concepts. I recently built a small AI‑powered app that automates routine task scheduling for small businesses; this project sharpened my skills in user research, interaction design, and testing with real users. I am excited about the opportunity to bring this blend of creativity, technical curiosity, and data‑driven mindset to Monzo’s product team.

Monzo’s mission to democratise banking aligns with my belief that great design can break down complex problems and make technology accessible. I am particularly drawn to your focus on continuous improvement and user‑first innovation. I am eager to contribute fresh ideas, collaborate cross‑functionally, and grow into a full‑stack designer who can help Monzo deliver intuitive, delightful experiences to millions of customers worldwide.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my background, passion for design, and AI‑project experience can support Monzo’s vision.  

Kind regards,

[Your Name]
